```{r}
    d <- compute_observation_diagnostics(panel, "sales", NULL, cfg)
    assert_true(d$n_groups == 3L && d$n_rows == 6L, "diagnostics see the eligible pre-band panel (A, B, C)")
    assert_true(d$same_month$n_same_month_pairs == 1L, "B is the single same-month pair")
    assert_true(d$extreme_ratio_total$n_pairs == 3L, "three consecutive pairs")
    panel[, band := data.table::fifelse(repeat_id == panel$repeat_id[[1]], "near", "far")]
    dg <- compute_observation_diagnostics(panel, "sales", "band", cfg)
    assert_true(all(c("near", "far") %in% dg$outcome_by_year$band), "grouping column is honoured")

# ---- U2 fixtures ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Two-site crosswalk over the configured years. Site 1 at (400000, 300000), site 2
# at (403000, 300000); `status_by_year` lets AE3 vary the monitoring history.
fixture_crosswalk <- function(status_by_year = rep("reported_positive", length(CONFIG$crosswalk_years)),
                              sites = tibble::tibble(site_id = 1:2, easting = c(400000, 403000), northing = 300000)) {
  years <- CONFIG$crosswalk_years
  tidyr::expand_grid(site_id = sites$site_id, year = years) |>
    dplyr::left_join(sites, by = "site_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      water_company = "Fixture Water",
      annual_status = status_by_year[match(.data$year, years)],
      ngr = "TQ000000"
    ) |>
    as.data.frame()
}

fixture_monthly <- function(jan_2014 = 2L) {
  # Sparse positive-count months, as in the real file: Feb 2014 absent, Oct 2014 absent.
  data.frame(
    year = c(2013L, 2014L, 2014L, 2014L, 2022L, 2022L, 2024L),
    month = c(12L, 1L, 3L, 4L, 7L, 8L, 12L),
    article_count = c(5L, jan_2014, 1L, 2L, 4L, 6L, 3L)
  )
}

fixture_evidence <- function(status = "established", coverage_end = as.Date("2025-06-01")) {
  list(status = status, reasons = if (status == "established") character() else "fixture: coverage unknown",
       coverage_end = if (status == "established") coverage_end else as.Date(NA))
}

FIXTURE_CHECKS$u2 <- list(

  band_boundaries_exact = function() {
    d <- c(0, 250, 500, 500.001, 750, 1000, 1000.001, 1500, 2000, 2000.001, NA)
    got <- assign_bands(d, CONFIG$bands)
    want <- c(1L, 1L, 1L, NA, NA, NA, 0L, 0L, 0L, NA, NA)
    assert_true(identical(got, want), sprintf("KTD5 boundaries: got %s", paste(got, collapse = ",")))
    assert_true(is.integer(got), "bands are integer")
    TRUE
  },

  nearest_matches_exhaustive_distances = function() {
    sites <- tibble::tibble(site_id = c(11L, 12L, 13L, 14L),
                            easting = c(400000, 401500, 404000, 399000), northing = c(300000, 300800, 299500, 302500),
                            usable = TRUE)
    props <- data.table::data.table(easting = c(400100, 401600, 403950, 399100, 402500, 400750),
                                    northing = c(300050, 300700, 299600, 302400, 300200, 300400))
    got <- nearest_site_distance(props, sites)
    full <- outer(seq_len(nrow(props)), seq_len(nrow(sites)), function(i, j) {
      sqrt((props$easting[i] - sites$easting[j])^2 + (props$northing[i] - sites$northing[j])^2)
    })
    want_site <- sites$site_id[apply(full, 1L, which.min)]
    want_dist <- apply(full, 1L, min)
    assert_true(identical(got$site_id, want_site), "nearest site equals the exhaustive minimum")
    assert_true(max(abs(got$distance_m - want_dist)) < 1e-6, "distance equals the exhaustive minimum")
    assert_true(nrow(got) == nrow(props), "one row per unique coordinate")
    TRUE
  },

  ae3_monitoring_history_leaves_exposure_unchanged = function() {
    always <- project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(rep("reported_positive", 4L)))
    late <- project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(c("absent", "absent", "absent", "reported_positive")))
    assert_true(identical(always$projection, late$projection), "AE3: projection identical when monitoring starts later")
    assert_true(!any(grepl("available", names(late$projection))), "no availability columns in the projection")
    props <- data.table::data.table(easting = c(400300, 401500), northing = 300000)
    a <- nearest_site_distance(props, always$projection)
    b <- nearest_site_distance(props, late$projection)
    assert_true(identical(a, b), "AE3: distances identical")
    assert_true(identical(assign_bands(a$distance_m), c(1L, 0L)), "300 m near; 1500 m far, regardless of monitoring")
    TRUE
  },

  unusable_site_counted_and_omitted = function() {
    sites <- tibble::tibble(site_id = 1:3, easting = c(400000, 403000, NA), northing = c(300000, 300000, NA))
    out <- project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(sites = sites))
    assert_true(out$n_sites == 3L && out$n_usable == 2L && out$n_unusable == 1L, "unusable site counted")
    assert_true(identical(out$unusable_site_ids, 3L), "site 3 is the unusable one")
    # A property that would sit on site 3 (had it a location) matches site 2 instead.
    got <- nearest_site_distance(data.table::data.table(easting = 405000, northing = 300000), out$projection)
    assert_true(got$site_id == 2L && abs(got$distance_m - 2000) < 1e-9, "unusable site omitted from matching")
    none <- tibble::tibble(site_id = 1:2, easting = NA_real_, northing = NA_real_)
    assert_error_matching(project_sites(fixture_crosswalk(sites = none)), "zero usable",
                          "zero usable sites stop matching")
    TRUE
  },

  zero_month_within_coverage_carries_stock_forward = function() {
    cal <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence("established"))
    assert_true(all(cal$article_status == "valid"), "calendar valid under established coverage")
    feb <- cal[cal$year == 2014L & cal$month == 2L, ]
    assert_true(feb$article_count == 0 && feb$article_stock == 2 && feb$log_articles == log(2), "absent Feb 2014 is zero and carries the stock")
    assert_true(cal$article_stock[cal$year == 2014L & cal$month == 4L] == 5, "stock cumulates 2+1+2")
    assert_true(!any(cal$article_stock > 5 + 4 + 6 + 3), "2013 articles are excluded from the stock")
    unknown <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence("unavailable"))
    assert_true(all(unknown$article_status == "blocked") && all(is.na(unknown$article_count)) &&
                  all(is.na(unknown$log_articles)), "unknown coverage blocks rather than zero-fills")
    assert_true(grepl("coverage not established", attr(unknown, "article_reason")), "reason names coverage")
    short <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence("established", as.Date("2020-12-01")))
    assert_true(all(short$article_status == "blocked") && grepl("coverage ends", short$article_reason[[1L]]),
                "coverage ending before the calendar end blocks")
    TRUE
  },

  article_input_validation_failures = function() {
    base <- fixture_monthly(2L)
    assert_true(validate_article_input(base)$status == "passed", "fixture passes validation")
    dup <- rbind(base, data.frame(year = 2014L, month = 3L, article_count = 1L))
    v <- validate_article_input(dup)
    assert_true(v$status == "failed" && any(grepl("duplicated", v$reasons)), "duplicate keys fail")
    miss <- base; miss$article_count[2] <- NA
    v <- validate_article_input(miss)
    assert_true(v$status == "failed" && any(grepl("missing article counts", v$reasons)), "missing counts fail")
    neg <- base; neg$article_count[2] <- -1L
    assert_true(any(grepl("negative", validate_article_input(neg)$reasons)), "negative counts fail")
    frac <- base; frac$article_count <- as.numeric(frac$article_count); frac$article_count[2] <- 1.5
    assert_true(any(grepl("non-integer", validate_article_input(frac)$reasons)), "non-integer counts fail")
    bad_month <- base; bad_month$month[2] <- 13L
    assert_true(any(grepl("month must be", validate_article_input(bad_month)$reasons)), "invalid month fails")
    blocked <- build_attention_calendar("sales", dup, fixture_evidence("established"))
    assert_true(all(blocked$article_status == "blocked") && grepl("validation failed", blocked$article_reason[[1L]]),
                "validation failure blocks the calendar")
    TRUE
  },

  missing_export_evidence_is_not_replaced_by_observed_dates = function() {
    ev <- article_export_evidence(pdf_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "no-such-export-dir"),
                                  articles_path = "no-such-articles.parquet", monthly_path = "no-such-monthly.parquet")
    assert_true(ev$status == "unavailable" && is.na(ev$coverage_end), "missing PDFs give unavailable evidence")
    # The monthly fixture spans 2013-2024, yet the calendar stays blocked.
    cal <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), ev)
    assert_true(all(cal$article_status == "blocked") && all(is.na(cal$log_articles)),
                "observed first/last dates do not establish coverage")
    TRUE
  },

  positive_initial_stock_required = function() {
    ok <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence())
    assert_true(ok$article_stock[[1L]] == 2 && ok$log_articles[[1L]] == log(2), "January 2014 stock of two is logged")
    zero <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(0L), fixture_evidence())
    assert_true(all(zero$article_status == "blocked") && grepl("origin month 2014-01", zero$article_reason[[1L]]),
                "zero initial stock blocks article cells")
    assert_true(zero$year[[1L]] == 2014L && zero$month[[1L]] == 1L && zero$article_stock[[1L]] == 0 &&
                  zero$article_stock[[3L]] == 1, "origin and cumulation unchanged; no offset or later origin")
    assert_true(all(is.na(zero$log_articles)), "no log1p substitute")
    TRUE
  },

  event_month_boundary_and_calendar_length = function() {
    sales <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence())
    rentals <- build_attention_calendar("rentals", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence())
    assert_true(nrow(sales) == 132L && nrow(rentals) == 120L, "132 sales months, 120 rental months")
    assert_true(sales$post[sales$year == 2022L & sales$month == 7L] == 0L, "July 2022 is pre")
    assert_true(sales$post[sales$year == 2022L & sales$month == 8L] == 1L, "August 2022 is post")
    assert_true(sales$year[[1L]] == 2014L && sales$month_index[[1L]] == 1L && all(diff(sales$month_index) == 1L),
                "calendar starts January 2014 with month_index 1 (no 2021-based indexing)")
    assert_true(sum(sales$post == 0L) == 103L && sum(sales$year < 2021L) == 84L, "earlier months intact")
    assert_true(sales$year[[132L]] == 2024L && sales$month[[132L]] == 12L && rentals$year[[120L]] == 2023L,
                "market-specific end months")
    TRUE
  },

  coverage_failure_keeps_post_columns_valid = function() {
    panel <- data.table::data.table(month_index = c(1L, 103L, 104L, 132L))
    blocked <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence("unavailable"))
    out <- attach_attention(panel, blocked)
    assert_true(identical(out$post, c(0L, 0L, 1L, 1L)), "post valid when article cells are blocked")
    assert_true(all(is.na(out$log_articles)), "log_articles NA when blocked")
    valid <- build_attention_calendar("sales", fixture_monthly(2L), fixture_evidence())
    out2 <- attach_attention(data.table::data.table(month_index = c(1L, 3L)), valid)
    assert_true(identical(out2$log_articles, c(log(2), log(3))), "log_articles joined by month_index")
    assert_error_matching(attach_attention(data.table::data.table(month_index = c(0L, 133L)), valid),
                          "no calendar month", "rows outside the calendar stop")
    TRUE
  },

  apply_exposure_bands_then_repeats_then_flags = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    # Fixture eastings run 400000-400070 on one northing, so one site places every
    # row in the same band: 400000 -> near (0-70 m); 398500 -> far (1500-1570 m);
    # 399250 -> omitted band (750-820 m).
    site_at <- function(e) tibble::tibble(site_id = 1L, easting = e, northing = 300000, usable = TRUE)
    out <- apply_exposure(contract$panel, site_at(400000), contract$ledger, "sales", cfg)
    steps <- out$ledger$step
    assert_true(identical(utils::tail(steps, 2L), c("distance_bands", "two_distinct_dates")), "band and repeat steps appended in order")
    assert_ledger_identity(out$ledger)
    p <- out$panel
    assert_true(all(c("site_id", "distance_m", "near", "band", "change_property_type", "any_change") %in% names(p)),
                "exposure and flag columns present")
    assert_true(all(is.finite(p$distance_m)) && all(p$near == 1L) && all(p$band == "near"), "every retained row has one exposure; all near")
    assert_true(out$ledger$n_rows_removed[steps == "distance_bands"] == 0 &&
                  out$ledger$n_rows_removed[steps == "two_distinct_dates"] == 4 &&
                  nrow(p) == 6L && data.table::uniqueN(p$repeat_id) == 3L, "bands keep 10 rows; singles D, E, G, H drop at two_distinct_dates")
    assert_true(!"h10" %in% p$id, "AE1 single drops at two_distinct_dates")
    assert_true(nrow(out$change_flags) == 3L && all(!p$any_change), "no property changes type; flags joined without restriction")
    far <- apply_exposure(contract$panel, site_at(398500), contract$ledger, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(all(far$panel$near == 0L) && nrow(far$panel) == 6L, "all rows far with the shifted site")
    omitted <- apply_exposure(contract$panel, site_at(399250), contract$ledger, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(omitted$ledger$n_rows_removed[omitted$ledger$step == "distance_bands"] == 10 && nrow(omitted$panel) == 0L,
                "rows in (500, 1000] leave at distance_bands")
    # A property whose type changes is flagged but retained.
    history2 <- data.table::copy(history)[house_id == "h02", property_type := "D"]
    out2 <- apply_exposure(apply_sample_contract(history2, mapping, "sales", cfg)$panel, site_at(400000), contract$ledger, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(all(out2$panel[id %in% c("h01", "h02"), any_change]) && nrow(out2$panel) == nrow(p),
                "changed property flagged and retained")
    TRUE
  }
)

fixture_results <- run_fixture_checks(FIXTURE_CHECKS)
```

```{r}
#| label: estimate
#| include: false
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate

# Per-market loop (U1 readiness -> U2 exposure and attention; U3 adds fitting).
# Shared inputs are loaded once; each market's pre-band panel is released as
# soon as the bands are applied.
site_projection <- load_site_projection(CONFIG$crosswalk_path, CONFIG$crosswalk_years)
article_input <- load_article_monthly(CONFIG$articles_path)
article_validation <- validate_article_input(article_input$monthly)
article_evidence <- article_export_evidence(CONFIG$article_pdf_dir, CONFIG$article_records_path, CONFIG$articles_path)
attention_calendars <- lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  build_attention_calendar(m, article_input$monthly, article_evidence, article_validation)
})
names(attention_calendars) <- MARKETS
input_provenance <- dplyr::bind_rows(site_projection$provenance, article_input$provenance, article_evidence$provenance)

readiness <- list()
observation_diagnostics <- list()
exclusion_ledger <- new_ledger()
market_data <- list()
for (market in MARKETS) {
  started <- Sys.time()
  prepared <- prepare_market_panel(market)
  readiness[[market]] <- prepared$readiness
  observation_diagnostics[[market]] <- prepared$diagnostics
  input_provenance <- dplyr::bind_rows(input_provenance, prepared$provenance)
  entry <- list(market = market, status = prepared$status, reason = prepared$reason, panel = NULL,
                change_flags = NULL, ledger = prepared$ledger, readiness = prepared$readiness,
                diagnostics = prepared$diagnostics, exposure_summary = NULL,
                calendar = attention_calendars[[market]])
  if (prepared$status == "ready") {
    exposure <- apply_exposure(prepared$panel, site_projection$projection, prepared$ledger, market)
    rm(prepared)
    invisible(gc())
    panel <- attach_attention(exposure$panel, attention_calendars[[market]])
    entry$panel <- panel
    entry$change_flags <- exposure$change_flags
    entry$ledger <- exposure$ledger
    entry$distance_summary_all <- exposure$distance_summary_all
    entry$exposure_summary <- exposure_summaries(panel, market)
    rm(exposure, panel)
  } else {
    rm(prepared)
  }
  entry$runtime_seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started, units = "secs"))
  exclusion_ledger <- dplyr::bind_rows(exclusion_ledger, entry$ledger)
  market_data[[market]] <- entry
  rm(entry)
  invisible(gc())
}
assert_ledger_identity(exclusion_ledger)
```

## Data readiness

The inputs are the two long-run transaction histories and their repeat mappings.
Every number below is computed at render time from those files; none is typed in.
A market is marked *blocked* when a validation step fails, and its model cells
are then reported as blocked rather than estimated on a substituted sample.

```{r}
#| label: readiness-status
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

status_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  r <- readiness[[m]]
  tibble::tibble(
    market = m, status = r$status,
    blocked_stage = r$blocked_stage %||% NA_character_,
    reason = r$reason %||% NA_character_,
    rows_pre_band = r$n_rows_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    groups_pre_band = r$n_groups_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band = r$n_rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band = r$n_groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    runtime_seconds = round(r$runtime_seconds, 1), peak_memory_mb = round(r$peak_memory_mb)
  )
}))
knitr::kable(status_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Market readiness after the pre-band sample contract")
```

### Current-address verification

Address keys and expected repeat ids are recomputed read-only on every
requested-window row that is in the mapping, singles included, with the
production `build_address_key()` and `hash_serialized_values()` contract and the
market's exact field order. Any missing current key or mismatched repeat id
blocks the market; nothing is rebuilt or repaired here.

```{r}
#| label: readiness-address
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

address_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  a <- readiness[[m]]$address_verification %||% readiness[[m]]$blocked_address_keys
  if (is.null(a)) return(tibble::tibble(market = m, status = readiness[[m]]$status))
  tibble::tibble(
    market = m, status = a$status, candidates = a$n_candidates, candidate_groups = a$n_candidate_groups,
    window_singles = a$n_window_singles, missing_current_keys = a$n_missing_keys,
    mismatched_repeat_ids = a$n_mismatched, mismatched_groups = a$n_mismatched_groups
  )
}))
knitr::kable(address_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "KTD10 current-address verification on requested-window mapped candidates")

geography_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  g <- readiness[[m]]$geography
  if (is.null(g)) return(tibble::tibble(market = m))
  tibble::tibble(market = m, groups_checked = g$n_groups_checked, rows_checked = g$n_rows_checked,
                 contradictory_groups = g$n_groups_contradictory, country = g$n_groups_country,
                 coordinates = g$n_groups_coordinates, lsoa = g$n_groups_lsoa, msoa = g$n_groups_msoa)
}))
knitr::kable(geography_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Contradictory nonmissing geography within candidate repeat groups (whole groups excluded)")
```

## Exposure and attention

Exposure is fixed from overflow locations alone. The Site Group crosswalk for
2021–2024 is projected to one representative location per Site Group with the
existing latest-valid rule; `annual_status` is read only so that the projection
helper can validate the crosswalk's structure, and no monitoring, spill or
availability information enters eligibility (AE3). Each unique property
coordinate is matched to its nearest usable Site Group with an STRtree-indexed
nearest-feature search in British National Grid metres, so no
coordinate-by-site matrix is ever formed. Near is 0–500 m inclusive, far is
greater than 1,000 m and at most 2,000 m; the intervening band and everything
beyond 2 km are dropped. The two-distinct-dates requirement is then recomputed
on the banded panel, and characteristic-change flags are frozen on that eligible
long-run panel before any complete-case or short-window restriction.

### Fixed site projection

```{r}
#| label: exposure-projection
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

projection_rows <- tibble::tibble(
  item = c("Crosswalk rows read", "Configured years", "Site Groups", "Usable locations (finite easting and northing)",
           "Site Groups without a valid location (counted, omitted from matching)", "Water companies",
           "Location rule", "Property coordinates", "Geography labels", "Postcode lookup (stated cleaning vintage)"),
  value = c(format_count(site_projection$n_crosswalk_rows),
            paste(range(site_projection$years), collapse = "-"),
            format_count(site_projection$n_sites), format_count(site_projection$n_usable),
            format_count(site_projection$n_unusable), format_count(site_projection$n_water_companies),
            "latest configured year with nonmissing NGR, easting and northing (derive_site_group_projection)",
            "postcode-centroid British National Grid coordinates from the ONS postcode lookup attached at cleaning",
            "2011 LSOA/MSOA codes",
            sprintf("%s (%s)", sub(paste0("^", here::here(), "/"), "", CONFIG$postcode_lookup_path),
                    ifelse(file.exists(CONFIG$postcode_lookup_path), "present", "absent")))
)
knitr::kable(projection_rows, format = "html", caption = "Fixed Site Group projection")
```

Distances are postcode-centroid to Site Group representative location, so
dwellings around a band boundary can be misclassified, and "far" means far from
a usable mapped representative rather than verified absence of a closer
unmapped overflow. Unique-coordinate counts relative to property counts (below)
show how many properties share a postcode centroid.

### Distance bands and repeat support

```{r}
                          caption = "Eligible long-run panel by band: rows, properties, unique coordinates, matched Site Groups and distance quantiles (m)"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(s$by_period, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),

  )
  emit_table(knitr::kable(precision, format = "html", caption = "Spatial precision on the eligible long-run panel"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(sp$quality_distribution, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                          caption = "Coordinate quality (ONS gridind)"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(d$group_sizes, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                          caption = "Observations per repeat group, by band"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(d$gap_summary, format = "html", digits = 3, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                          caption = "Inter-observation gaps (days), by band"))

  if (!is.null(d$rented_fallback_by_year)) {
```

### Attention calendar

The attention measures are a post indicator (August 2022 onward, set from the
configured event month and independent of any helper's base year) and the log
of the cumulative count of search-1 LexisNexis articles from January 2014. The
stock excludes every earlier article. Absent months are filled with zero only
inside established coverage of this fixed corpus, which is recomputed here from
the export PDFs: contiguous result segments across the export files, per-file
record counts that sum to the extracted article rows, an article-level monthly
`n()` that reproduces the monthly file, and one query with no date narrowing on
every cover page. Observed first and last article dates never stand in for that
evidence. When any check fails, the article cells are blocked and the post and
annual-profile analyses continue.

Established coverage certifies only that the extraction matches the export of
this one Boolean search at export time. The July 2026 LexisNexis refinement
plan documents off-topic matches and merged article boundaries with potentially
misassigned metadata in this corpus; those limits are inherited here without
filtering or repair, and the counts do not certify comprehensive or
compositionally constant UK media coverage.

```{r}
#| label: attention-evidence
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

validation_rows <- tibble::tibble(
  item = c("Monthly input status", "Rows (observed positive-count months)", "Articles in observed months",
           "First and last observed months", "Reasons"),
  value = c(article_validation$status, format_count(article_validation$n_rows),
            format_count(article_validation$n_articles),
            paste(article_validation$first_month, article_validation$last_month, sep = " to "),
            ifelse(length(article_validation$reasons) == 0L, "none", paste(article_validation$reasons, collapse = "; ")))
)
emit_table(knitr::kable(validation_rows, format = "html", caption = "Article input validation (search1_monthly)"))

ev <- article_evidence
if (nrow(ev$files) > 0L) {
  files_display <- dplyr::select(ev$files, file, pages, export_date, job_number, search_type, first_result,
                                 n_date_fields, date_restriction_detected)
  emit_table(knitr::kable(files_display, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                          caption = sprintf("Export PDFs (cover fields and result lists). Search terms on every cover: %s", ev$search_terms)))
}
evidence_rows <- tibble::tibble(
  item = c("Coverage status", "Segments contiguous (first results 1, 501, ...)", "PDF record fields",
           "Extracted article rows", "Records reconciled", "Article-level monthly n() reproduces the monthly file",
           "Months compared / mismatched", "Query and cover narrowing consistent across files", "Date restriction on cover",
           "Article dates in the extraction", "Earliest export date", "Established coverage end", "Reasons"),
  value = c(ev$status, as.character(ev$segments_contiguous), format_count(ev$n_records_pdf),
            format_count(ev$n_articles_file), as.character(ev$records_reconciled), as.character(ev$monthly_reproduced),
            paste(ev$n_months_compared, ev$n_months_mismatched, sep = " / "), as.character(ev$query_consistent),
            as.character(ev$date_restriction_detected),
            paste(ev$article_date_min, ev$article_date_max, sep = " to "), as.character(ev$export_date_min),
            as.character(ev$coverage_end),
            ifelse(length(ev$reasons) == 0L, "none", paste(ev$reasons, collapse = "; ")))
)
emit_table(knitr::kable(evidence_rows, format = "html", caption = "Export reconciliation and coverage evidence (recomputed at render time)"))

calendar_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  cal <- attention_calendars[[m]]
  tibble::tibble(
    market = m, months = nrow(cal), first = sprintf("%04d-%02d", cal$year[[1L]], cal$month[[1L]]),
    last = sprintf("%04d-%02d", cal$year[[nrow(cal)]], cal$month[[nrow(cal)]]),
    post_months = sum(cal$post), article_status = cal$article_status[[1L]],
    origin_stock = cal$article_stock[[1L]], final_stock = cal$article_stock[[nrow(cal)]],
    reason = ifelse(is.na(cal$article_reason[[1L]]), "", cal$article_reason[[1L]])
  )
}))
emit_table(knitr::kable(calendar_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                        caption = "Attention calendars by market"))
```

```{r}
sales_calendar <- attention_calendars$sales
if (all(sales_calendar$article_status == "valid")) {
  plot_attention_history(sales_calendar)
} else {
  cat("Attention history not plotted: ", attr(sales_calendar, "article_reason"), "\n")
}
```
